definitions.explanation: Lacking compassion or mercy; showing no pity. Used to describe people, actions, or abstract forces (like fate or nature) that are unforgiving. Composed of 無 (without) + 慈悲 (mercy/compassion).

examples.japanese: {無慈悲|むじひ}な{仕打|しう}ち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{耐|た}えた→耐える：12087_taeru⟧。
⟦{自然|しぜん}{災害|さいがい}→自然災害：29290_shizensaigai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無慈悲|むじひ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{奪|うば}う→奪う：01895_ubau⟧。
examples.english: Natural disasters mercilessly rob people of their livelihoods.

examples.english: A documentary conveying the merciless reality of war was broadcast.

notes:
USAGE:
{無慈悲|むじひ} is a na-adjective: {無慈悲|むじひ}な (attributive) and {無慈悲|むじひ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (adverbial). It is a literary or formal word, more commonly found in writing, news, and dramatic contexts than in casual conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無慈悲|むじひ}な⟦{攻撃|こうげき}→攻撃：02748_kougeki⟧ (merciless attack)
- {無慈悲|むじひ}な{仕打|しう}ち (cruel treatment)
- {無慈悲|むじひ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}り{捨|す}てる→切り捨てる：05747_kirisuteru⟧ (ruthlessly discard)
- {無慈悲|むじひ}な⟦{現実|げんじつ}→現実：02720_genjitsu⟧ (merciless reality)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{冷酷|れいこく}→冷酷：15089_reikoku⟧ means "cold-hearted" or "ruthless" with an emphasis on emotional coldness. ⟦{残酷|ざんこく}→残酷：13201_zankoku⟧ means "cruel" or "brutal" and emphasizes the infliction of suffering. ⟦{非情|ひじょう}→非情：16027_hijou⟧ means "heartless" or "unfeeling."
